titleEn: Smallest K-Length Subsequence With Occurrences of a Letter
title: 含特定字母的最小子序列
summary: 求长度 k、至少含 repetition 个指定 letter 的字典序最小子序列。
insight: 单调栈删除较大字符，但必须保证剩余位置足以填满 k，且弹出 letter 后仍能凑够 repetition。压入非 letter 时还要为尚缺的 letter 预留槽位。
pitfalls: 结果长度必须恰为 k
letter 至少出现 repetition 次
弹栈与压栈都要保护字母配额

solutions.title: 配额感知单调栈
solutions.idea: 在普通最小子序列栈上加入指定字母数量约束。
steps: 遍历 i：满足栈顶更大、剩余位置够填满、弹出字母后配额仍可达时弹栈
若栈未满：letter 直接入；非 letter 仅当剩余槽位多于尚缺 letter 时入；最后扣当前 remainingLetter

code.java: class Solution { public String smallestSubsequence(String s,int k,char letter,int repetition){int remainingLetter=0;for(char value:s.toCharArray())if(value==letter)remainingLetter++;StringBuilder stack=new StringBuilder();int usedLetter=0,n=s.length();for(int i=0;i<n;i++){char value=s.charAt(i);while(stack.length()>0&&stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)>value&&stack.length()+n-i>k&&(stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)!=letter||usedLetter-1+remainingLetter>=repetition)){if(stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)==letter)usedLetter--;stack.deleteCharAt(stack.length()-1);}if(stack.length()<k){if(value==letter){stack.append(value);usedLetter++;}else if(k-stack.length()>repetition-usedLetter)stack.append(value);}if(value==letter)remainingLetter--;}return stack.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun smallestSubsequence(s:String,k:Int,letter:Char,repetition:Int):String{var remainingLetter=s.count{it==letter};val stack=StringBuilder();var usedLetter=0;for(i in s.indices){val value=s[i];while(stack.isNotEmpty()&&stack.last()>value&&stack.length+s.length-i>k&&(stack.last()!=letter||usedLetter-1+remainingLetter>=repetition)){if(stack.last()==letter)usedLetter--;stack.deleteCharAt(stack.lastIndex)};if(stack.length<k){if(value==letter){stack.append(value);usedLetter++}else if(k-stack.length>repetition-usedLetter)stack.append(value)};if(value==letter)remainingLetter--};return stack.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string smallestSubsequence(string s,int k,char letter,int repetition){int remainingLetter=count(s.begin(),s.end(),letter),usedLetter=0,n=s.size();string stack;for(int i=0;i<n;++i){char value=s[i];while(!stack.empty()&&stack.back()>value&&(int)stack.size()+n-i>k&&(stack.back()!=letter||usedLetter-1+remainingLetter>=repetition)){if(stack.back()==letter)--usedLetter;stack.pop_back();}if((int)stack.size()<k){if(value==letter){stack+=value;++usedLetter;}else if(k-(int)stack.size()>repetition-usedLetter)stack+=value;}if(value==letter)--remainingLetter;}return stack;} };
